description: Design and ship an ONLINE cache replacement (eviction) policy for a DRAM object cache that replays a real Meta production kvcache trace published for CacheBench, and beat CacheLib's default LRU on HIT RATE at a fixed cache capacity.

score.name: hit_rate
score.definition: hits / lookups on the held-out workload at the frozen capacity
score.external_basis: CacheBench reports cache hit ratio; the cache literature reports the complement (miss ratio). No composite weights, bonuses or penalties are used.

workload.family: CacheLib workload sharing bucket (Meta published cache traces for CacheBench)

replay_semantics.ignore_op_count_basis: cachelib/cachebench/util/Config.h:275-276 ('ignore opCount and does not repeat operations'), parsed at util/Config.cpp:61
replay_semantics.lookups: CacheBench enableLookaside semantics ('follow get misses with a set', Config.h:271) = the classic reference-stream model: every reference is a cache lookup and a miss loads the object
replay_semantics.skip_delete_ops: DELETE rows are excluded deterministically (the frozen canonical protocol has no delete channel); count recorded per workload
replay_semantics.model: full associativity, unit-size objects, one resident victim per overflow, no lenient fallback

capacity.definition: cache can hold at most cache_size resident objects
capacity.fraction_basis: documented cache-size sweep values (libCacheSim plot_mrc_size --sizes=0.001,...,0.4; cachesim ... 0.001,0.01,0.1,0.2)
capacity.selection_criterion: the documented fraction with the largest LRU -> offline-optimum headroom on this workload (0.166171 hits, vs 0.136724 at 0.01 and 0.149938 at 0.05)
capacity.cachebench_equivalent_field: cache_config.cacheSizeMB (byte capacity; not transferable to a sampled prefix - CacheLib documents resource scaling for reduced traces)

reference_policies.offline_optimum_note: Belady 1966; a bound only, never a submission
